ActorTalk: I know progress always comes with sacrifice. But once we start calling everything "sacrifice," death just becomes a noble statistic... and suffering turns into background noise.
I often ask myself: Did I do enough? Could I have saved more?
The ones I couldn't save... are they just the inevitable cost of moving forward?
If you carry every loss on your shoulders, you'll never reach the end of the road.
If I'd met you sooner, I might not have wandered so long in that doubt. Now, the best I can do is try to make sure fewer fall along the way.
You don't have to carry that weight alone. We walk this path together.
Right. And that's how we honor those who walked it before us.
